name: ribbon-yard-equipment
about: A sound square ad: a white tractor at a fuel island at night. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `ribbon` look (centred Anton headline, pill button, a hairline over the legal line): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-yard-equipment`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: a night scene, the truck legible, the kit's colours

subject_legible.reason: A white sleeper tractor under a lit fuel canopy stands out sharply against the dark night and reads instantly as a truck.

words_match_picture.reason: A call for Class A OTR drivers sits over a sleeper tractor at a fuel stop, which fits over-the-road work without adding a more specific story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large white headline dominates, the white pill button below clearly reads as a button, and the truck sits above without fighting the text.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green wash and white type and button match the two brand colours, and no logo was supplied, though nothing else marks the carrier.
